intermediate.pointer: On the course panel, type this pool, the 72 m target and the 0.765 transmissivity into the Fire explorer's heat flux view: it runs the whole chain unrounded and prints every value to at least the precision graded here.

yokri_flame_length_with_wind_m.evidence: The Heat view now runs on the pool the learner types (typedPoolFire in consequenceLab.js: poolBurningRate, poolFireSolidFlame and surfaceEmissivePower, nothing rounded between steps). Typing the prompt's pool (kerosene, 31.5 m, 6 m/s, 1.2 kg/m3, 1.48e-5 m2/s, 43000000 J/kg, 0.235, 0.8) with the target at 72 m and transmissivity 0.765 prints the value within tol; yourCase.test.jsx proves it and that the ERHA default lands on no graded answer.
